parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

get.description: All Segments for a given company

parameters.name: include[]
parameters.description: Optional sideloads to include in each segment object. Valid values: 'tier_depth' (adds the tier_depth integer field), 'action_policy' (adds the action_policy object with permitted actions for the current user). Multiple values may be passed as include[]=tier_depth&include[]=action_policy.

parameters.name: include_action_policy
parameters.description: Convenience flag equivalent to passing include[]=action_policy. When true, each segment includes an action_policy object describing permitted actions for the current user.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this WBS Segment. Use as the {id} path parameter in GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/work_breakdown_structure/segments/{id}.

type.description: The segment type. One of: 'sub_job' (sub-job dimension), 'cost_code' (cost code dimension), 'line_item_type' (line item type dimension), 'custom' (user-defined custom segment), 'attribute' (attribute dimension). Only 'custom' segments can be created via the API.

name.description: Localized display name of this WBS Segment shown in the UI (e.g. "Cost Code", "Phase"). Corresponds to the i18n label, not the internal segment_type value.

position.description: Ordinal position of this segment within the company WBS pattern. Lower values appear first. Use to determine column order in budget code displays.

segment_items_count.description: Total number of segment items belonging to this segment. Use to gauge  whether a segment has been populated before attempting to list segment items.

required.description: Whether this segment must have a value assigned when creating a WBS Code. When true, budget codes cannot be created without selecting an item from this segment.

delimiter.description: Character that separates this segment's value from the next segment's value in a formatted WBS code string (e.g. '.' produces "01.02").

project_can_modify_origin_project.description: Whether project-specific segment items can be added, edited, or removed from a project. When true, project admins may manage items in this segment independently of the company list.

project_can_delete_origin_company.description: Whether segment items inherited from the company level can be deleted from a project. When true, project admins may remove company-defined items from the project's visible list.

structure.description: Hierarchy structure of this segment. 'tiered' means items can have parent-child relationships forming a multi-level tree; 'flat' means all items are at a single level with no hierarchy.

tier_depth.description: Present only when include[]=tier_depth is requested (list endpoints only).  Flat segments (sub_job, line_item_type) return 1; tiered segments return  the number of levels. Omitted (not null) when not requested.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this segment was created. Use to sort or filter segments by creation date.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this segment was last modified. Use to detect whether cached segment data needs to be refreshed.

wbs_pattern_id.description: ID of the WBS Pattern this segment belongs to. Use to correlate this segment with its parent pattern returned by GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/work_breakdown_structure/patterns.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
